decisionMaker.authorityBasis: The user explicitly identifies themself as the project's highest decision-maker and authorizes the Decision A and B policy in the conversation. No account name or legal name is inferred.

decisionA.canonicalReconciliation: Canonical does not grant presentation eligibility; an effective scoped Presentation Contract controls that downstream permission.
decisionA.evidenceReconciliation: Evidence does not itself authorize Generated or frontend publication; the effective scoped Presentation Contract controls that downstream permission.
decisionA.semanticInvariant: Preserve all existing IDs, explicit relations, source fields, Chinese source strings, source commit, and provenance byte-for-byte.

requiredDisclosures: 중국어 ConfigData 원문 설명이며 공식 한국어 번역이 아닙니다.
LevelInfo ID는 원본 레코드 식별자이며 게임 레벨이나 진행 순서를 뜻하지 않습니다.
SP 설명의 슬롯·시점·게임 내 적용 의미는 확인되지 않았습니다.
decisionB.rendering: Treat source strings as text; only the validated exact color token pair may become fixed DOM spans. Never execute arbitrary markup.
decisionB.scopeExpansion: No records outside the exact 20 claims, IDs, fields, and pinned source commit are authorized.

reviewConditions: Any change to source commit, IDs, fields, records, disclosures, consumer surfaces, or rendering semantics requires a new review.
On revocation, future UI use and new Build publication must be disabled; previously published static files, GitHub history, caches, and external copies are not represented as erased.
